input.quote: 16.2 Indemnification of Ono. Array shall indemnify and hold harmless each of Ono, its Affiliates and Sublicensees and the directors, officers and employees of Ono, its Affiliates and Sublicensees and the successors and assigns of any of the foregoing (the "Ono Indemnitees"), from and against any and all Liabilities from any Third Party Claims incurred by any Ono Indemnitee, arising from, or occurring as a result of:
input.rationale: No insurance provision exists anywhere in the Agreement: a document-wide search for "insurance" returns only Net Sales deduction and payer references (p0101, p0102), and Article XVI (Indemnification; Recalls, p0715–p0733) and the General Provisions contain no coverage covenant. Array undertakes substantive risk-bearing activities toward Ono — it conducts Clinical Studies (including under Joint Development Plans), manufactures and supplies Product under Article IX, and indemnifies Ono for Products Liability Claims and clinical trial injury under Section 16.2 — so the rule expects an insurance clause and its complete absence sits below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and in walk-away territory for a counterparty performing on-site and data-handling activities. We therefore insert a short Section 16.7 at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, product and clinical trial liability USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Array handles our data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), adapted to the pharma context and with a self-insurance option; a mutual clause or the fallback limits would also be acceptable.

proposal.summary: Insert insurance covenant (Section 16.7) requiring Array to maintain CGL, product/clinical trial liability and cyber coverage, with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance undertaking, so Array's indemnities under Section 16.2 (including Products Liability Claims and clinical trial injury) are unsupported by coverage. We have added a short Section 16.7 requiring commercial general liability of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, product and clinical trial liability of USD 2,000,000, cyber liability of USD 5,000,000 where Array handles our data, statutory workers' compensation and certificates on request; we can make the clause mutual or accept USD 1,000,000 product liability and USD 2,000,000 cyber cover if that is easier for Array.

ops.text: 16.7 Insurance. Array shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter, insurance with reputable insurers: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) product liability insurance (including clinical trial liability coverage in respect of Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Array) of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Array processes any Confidential Information of Ono or personal data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance as required by applicable Law. Array shall provide Ono with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon Ono's request, and shall notify Ono promptly of any cancellation or material adverse change in such coverage. Array may satisfy the foregoing requirements through a program of self-insurance of comparable scope and amount.
